_about: SignedStatement v2 (security review 2026-10, root cause A §1.1-§1.3). Hand-authored; expected bytes computed by an INDEPENDENT oracle (Node/OpenSSL Ed25519 + X25519, BigInt Edwards-to-Montgomery), never by an engine. Signer = sharedgrant.json member seed, so the joint-key mapping is pinned against existing accounts.
